archetype: continuous urban rowhouse block composed of individually legible attached dwellings, with stoops, party walls, narrow domestic floorplates, rear service yards and coherent street-to-home circulation
ground_program: continuous street wall broken into multiple individually legible rowhouse frontages rather than one undifferentiated facade
each dwelling has its own principal street entrance, stoop or short raised approach, and a recognizable threshold sequence into a domestic hall or front room
front living or reception room, rear kitchen or dining zone, and compact sanitation/service space arranged around an actual internal circulation path
party walls remain continuous enough to make each dwelling a distinct attached unit while still allowing occasional historically plausible shared service penetrations
rear doors connect kitchens or service halls to small fenced yards, alleys, sheds, bins, wash areas or utility fixtures without routing service traffic through neighboring homes
cellar or under-stair storage is used where vertical grade and footprint permit, with supported access rather than decorative trapdoors or sealed voids
street drainage, stoops, basement areaways, rear-yard grade and alley transitions seat the entire block into terrain without a monolithic platform
corner or end units react to exposed side walls with different openings, room proportions, yard access or service placement instead of duplicating interior units unchanged
upper_program: each dwelling contains a vertically continuous domestic stair with supported landings, uninterrupted player headroom and destinations on every occupied floor
upper floors contain inferable bedroom, small study or nursery, and sanitation zones rather than empty repeated boxes
party-wall alignment remains consistent floor to floor so attached homes read as separate structural bays within one block
front and rear windows serve real occupied rooms and align plausibly with floor levels rather than floating as facade decoration
roof form is divided by dwelling bay using parapets, chimneys, dormers, party-wall upstands or stepped ridge lines so the block remains legible as many homes
attic or roof service access appears only where a real stair, hatch or maintenance route supports it
end and corner units receive distinct side-wall conditions, roof returns or circulation adjustments appropriate to their exposed geometry
circulation: every dwelling provides a continuous route from its own street entrance through domestic rooms to its rear service exit without passing through another dwelling
domestic stairs connect every occupied level with supported treads, landings and adequate headroom at turns
rear yards and alley routes remain distinct from principal residential entry paths and provide a believable refuse, delivery and maintenance route
adjacent dwellings remain separated by party walls except where a deliberate breach, shared passage or damage event is authored
corner units preserve a coherent route despite their different footprint and do not inherit impossible corridor geometry from middle units
damage variants must preserve at least one complete street-to-rear route in multiple surviving dwellings and at least one usable vertical route through the block
damage_constraints: the damaged derivative must still read as a continuous rowhouse block made of multiple attached homes, not as a generic rubble strip
favor localized fire spread, roof loss, party-wall exposure, partial facade collapse, burst utilities, boarded openings and yard overgrowth over repeated rectangular deletion masks
damage may propagate across one or two neighboring dwellings, but surviving units must retain clear individual boundaries and domestic programs
where a floor or roof collapses, associated walls, stairs, windows, furnishings and debris must tell the same gravity-coherent structural story
preserve enough intact stairs, kitchens, bedrooms, stoops and rear yards across the block for residential identity to remain immediately inferable
party-wall breaches must expose believable neighboring interiors rather than arbitrary holes into empty cells
rear yards, alleys, sheds and service fixtures should show localized abandonment or damage while remaining connected to their associated dwellings
derive damaged, occupied or contaminated variants only from this immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: the structure reads immediately as several distinct attached urban rowhouses rather than one apartment building or one long generic shell
each dwelling has a believable front entrance, domestic room sequence, vertical stair and rear service connection
party walls, floorplates and roof divisions preserve individual dwelling identity while still forming a continuous urban street wall
stairs are vertically supported, land on real floors and provide continuous player-scale headroom
front and rear windows correspond to actual occupied rooms and floor levels
rear yards and alley/service routes belong to specific dwellings and remain spatially legible
damage is localized and gravity-coherent while preserving multiple readable homes and at least one complete vertical route
the block meets street, sidewalk, areaway, rear-yard and alley grades without floating foundations, buried entrances or a rectangular artificial podium
